lines: +# The RCSB fasta service now reports each mature fluorescent-protein
+# chromophore as a single 'X' instead of the three precursor residues
+# that must actually be encoded in DNA (the chromophore forms
+# post-translationally from them). Expand X back to the precursor
+# tripeptides for the selected donor (Clover, 5WJ2: ..TTFGYGVAC..) and
+# acceptor (mCherry, 2H5Q: ..SPQFMYGSK..), and fail loudly if any other
+# X survives, since DNA cannot encode X and DNACisel would otherwise
+# report a misleading "wrong translation" at exactly those codons.
+assert "X" not in donor + acceptor + snap + dhfr, (
+    "unexpanded non-standard residue X in selected sequences"
